deterministicFindings.message: MaterialityAssessment --assessesIncident--> Incident looks like the inverse of Incident --hasMaterialityAssessment--> MaterialityAssessment. The profile is one directed relationship per real-world connection, never also its inverse.

llmFindings.subject: declareMajorIncident
llmFindings.message: The precondition canDeclareMajorIncident requires an incident commander to already be assigned, but the action effect also says the incident commander is assigned by declaring the major incident.

llmFindings.subject: closeIncident
llmFindings.message: The verification requires the closure timestamp to be recorded accurately, but the effect only updates status to closed and does not state that closedAt is recorded.

llmFindings.subject: communicateIncidentStatus
llmFindings.message: The verification requires the communication to be archived, but the effect only says the communication is logged and does not state any archived status.

llmFindings.subject: performMaterialityAssessment
llmFindings.message: The verification requires reviewing the incident's materiality assessment record, but the effect only says an assessment is conducted and documented without establishing the Incident-to-MaterialityAssessment link needed by the model.

llmFindings.subject: canCloseIncident
llmFindings.message: The rule requires all impacted IT services to have an acceptable status, but no class defines what statuses are acceptable for ITService so the condition is unusable as stated.
